title: Tyler Wright
text:
Summary
Computer Science senior at BYU-Idaho focused on AI-assisted workflows, business automation, backend systems, and practical technology solutions for real organizations. Experienced building Python automation pipelines, OCR-based document processing tools, Google Drive API integrations, machine learning projects, and Elixir/OTP systems. Strong at translating business needs into tested technical solutions that improve workflow efficiency, usability, and operational reliability.

title: Tyler Wright
text:
Education
2023 – Present Brigham Young University - Idaho, Rexburg, ID Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
2018 – 2022 Los Medanos College, Pittsburg, CA Associate of Science in Electrical Technology

title: Tyler Wright
text:
Projects

Automated Purchase Order Document Routing System — Senior Project

Designed and implemented an end-to-end Python automation system for processing scanned purchase order PDFs in a real automotive repair business
Built a multi-stage pipeline for PDF conversion, OCR processing, text extraction, document classification, and Google Drive routing
Used Tesseract OCR, Poppler/PDF2Image, regex, and spatial text analysis to identify purchase order numbers from image-based documents
Developed rule-based classification logic for purchase orders, returns, no-PO documents, and manual review cases
Integrated the Google Drive API to route documents into structured destination folders based on classification results
Added logging, batch processing, and run-level summaries to support testing, troubleshooting, and operational reliability
Built around real business requirements, edge cases, and user workflow needs to reduce repetitive manual file handling



Procession — Elixir/OTP RPG Simulation System

Designed and developed a personal single-player RPG simulation project using Elixir and OTP as the authoritative simulation kernel
Built architecture around supervised entity processes, message passing, world ticks, agent state, memory, dialogue constraints, and behavior validation
Created a separation between inert world data, active simulation scopes, and live entity processes to support scalable world generation
Implemented rule-based NPC dialogue systems that track relationship context, trust changes, topic pressure, and disclosure boundaries
Designed AI-assisted content workflows where generated behavior metadata is treated as untrusted data until validated by deterministic Elixir systems
Added SQLite-backed world storage to support durable world data while keeping live simulation state under OTP supervision
Built tests and IEx/demo workflows to verify player-facing behavior, NPC responses, internal state changes, and simulation rules



Machine Learning Model Development & Evaluation

Built and evaluated supervised learning and deep learning models using Python, pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn
Applied preprocessing, feature engineering, train/test evaluation, and model comparison across multiple datasets
Used confusion matrices, precision, recall, F1 score, ROC-AUC, and overfitting analysis to explain model performance
Created clear summaries of model results for decision-making and project reporting



Tetris Clone — Rust Individual Project

Built an early-stage Tetris clone in Rust while learning the language independently
Implemented core game mechanics including piece movement, board state management, and collision detection
Designed modular components to organize game logic and improve maintainability
Used the project to strengthen understanding of Rust ownership, control flow, and structured game development

title: Tyler Wright
text:
Technical Skills
Primary Languages: Python, Elixir, Erlang
Additional Languages: JavaScript, Rust, C++, Java, C#
Automation & AI Tools: OCR, Tesseract, PDF2Image, rule-based classification, AI-assisted workflows, local model evaluation
Web & Business Technology: JavaScript, API integrations, workflow automation, user-focused tools, business process improvement
Data & Machine Learning: scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, preprocessing, feature engineering, model evaluation, confusion matrices
Backend & Systems: Elixir/OTP, supervision trees, process-based architecture, message passing, SQLite, command-line workflows
APIs & Integrations: Google Drive API, file routing automation, batch processing, JSON/JSONL workflows
Development Tools: Git, VS Code, IntelliJ IDEA, Linux, terminal-based development
Business & Workflow Skills: Requirements gathering, documentation, testing, troubleshooting, user support, process improvement

title: Tyler Wright
text:
Work Experience
Pocatello, ID Family Auto Care — Business Workflow Automation Developer

Identified business workflow problems and developed technical solutions to reduce repetitive manual work
Built and tested internal automation tools for document handling, file organization, and operational efficiency
Worked directly with real business users to understand requirements, test edge cases, and improve system usability
Supported process improvement efforts by combining technical development with practical shop operations knowledge
Assisted with daily business operations, gaining firsthand experience with how technology affects customer service, productivity, and staff workload
Helped connect technical improvements to practical business outcomes such as faster document handling, better organization, and reduced manual follow-up

Pittsburg, CA TOGO’s — Team Member

Worked in a fast-paced customer service environment requiring reliability, communication, time management, and attention to detail

title: Tyler Wright
text:
Volunteer Experience
2020 – 2022 Missionary, The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, Las Vegas, NV

Served full-time in a role requiring daily planning, communication, service coordination, goal tracking, and weekly reporting
Continued regular Japanese language study while serving
Developed communication, discipline, adaptability, leadership, and problem-solving skills
